notes.title: Post BGS + First Patch of Improvements + Renovated Office + Free Key...
notes.content:
Hi guys, I'm here to bring you some news.

1 - The first one is to tell you that the BGS (Brasil Game Show) was amazing, I got to meet many people and other developers. I also gave gifts to several visitors and influencers at the Parallel booth, this was a way for me to repay all the support. Check out some images:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/21a30a99499cc0b6178cc4b9a0b07880965a294d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/a29d11378741e402ed3b8994b436fae52953f2de.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/c57a078d00273d5b3dad3fa543b23a19e43e43ac.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/9f91ad1a7a72df3f7f5eed4672ed02cf0ac12617.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/aef5aab8d92a18c3689356d44b48d01c0dd54807.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/537decbc40735f584ac78f8a60c2760b265611fa.jpg[/img]

2 - I bring the first patch of corrections and improvements (the update is automatic), they are:

> I removed a locking point behind the monkey house which held the little soul.
> I changed the X format icon to a slash, before they confused it with the X on the control
> I removed some sound errors in case the player dies in the maze and elsewhere
> I fixed the achievement "Land of Fire" that previously didn't work when entering the cave of fire.
> fixed the last life bug that made the player invincible

I'm evaluating the possibility of facilitating and creating more continue slots, still, the game has a high difficulty to cause more tension and challenge.

3 - The other news is that the player S.r-Billy was the winner of the special edition of Parallel and has already received this award at his home. He very quickly captured and posted a YouTube video showing how to take on this challenge. He also created some game manuals to help the Parallel community. Thank you Billy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/595c80db6dac6dadbb2925a0831bd39fff2c7e8a.jpg[/img]

I'm also finishing up my office, I had to paint and fix the lights and the air conditioning that was broken. I'm already working on the post-launch of Parallel. I want to bring additional content later this year, I'm working very hard for it, wait. See some pictures of my renovated office:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/04e8f43b7d0c503c3af35575c50df1c9f7aa0ea4.jpg[/img]

And finally, if you've made it this far and you're the first one reading this, this game key is yours: IIYHN-BN5PW-NLD80

Once again, a very, very big thank you to everyone who follows me and cheers for the success of the game. The page reviews help a lot and I would be very happy to have your support. I always want to improve, learn and inspire others.

notes.title: Parallel + Developer KIT + BGS 2022 + Cosplay - JOIN
notes.content:
[h3]I am always believing in the positive mind and positive attitude. As a way to demonstrate this attitude and thank you for all the support I've had, I cosplayed and prepared 12 developer editions of the game.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/2d069c5ceb813e4557927a509d9492c5dd9eaa56.jpg[/img]

Some editions are for my YouTube partners. But I have a few more to give away to the community. Everyone who comes to visit me at the Brasil Game Show, which will take place from October 6th to 12th, will already be in the running. It will be an event for celebration, an event to be remembered forever, and I will be there to take a picture with you and give you a lot of positive energy, straight from the Parallel universe.

[h3]I'm also creating a challenge in the game, follow the videos on YouTube to stay on top of this challenge. This edition can be yours.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=ytgJ4J5GCaQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all from my heart and I'm going with faith until the end, because it's what moves me forward. I believe 100% in the power of the gamer community, I'm producing and releasing the game alone, without any publisher, but believe me, with you I don't feel alone, there were more than 250 thousand views and 11 thousand comments on YouTube. Seriously, thank you, thank you very much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/1685a69e5a68e34901d175843a1dd87363c73f4c.jpg[/img]

And finally, I'm producing 2 new trailers that will come out on YouTube, one for pre-launch and one for launch, I'll post it here on the store page when it's time. I count on everyone's support to help me spread Parallel to the maximum number of players.

[h3]Thanks. And may you all believe and succeed in your dreams, may the greater force light your way and increase your faith always![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38475560/123b71a670bbc250d326ae1bfc275f1de1658771.jpg[/img]
